contract: Each of 16 children and each of 54 lanes at every full-carrier block equals the existing Radix split and selected PaperVerifier honest-witness specification, computed from independently Lean-replayed R parent ranges. Native children are comparison targets only.

assessments.independence: Lean receives only parent ranges and output/range paths. No native child value or expected mask selects its digits. The exact Lean R producer and parent bytes must be bound by existing execution provenance.
assessments.kernel: computeBlock calls StoredSplit.splitChecked. It checks every supplied coefficient against centeredMagnitude < Radix.combinedBound before computing all 16 Radix.boundedDigit values. splitChecked_value and splitChecked_block_honestWitness state the scalar and actual-block correspondence. Compilation remains owned by the coordinator.
assessments.strict_bound_and_fields: The selected bound is 65536. Canonical parent words are checked below goldilocksModulus before fieldOfNat, so modular reduction cannot accept an out-of-range word. Both centered signs use the existing scalar split.
assessments.masks: childMasks visits all 54 returned values and accepts only 0, 1, -1. Rust decode_masks rejects repeated or unordered child IDs, overlap, bits above lane 53, and empty or explicit zero entries. Actual compact Mat masks come from the existing validated Mat deserializer/accessor. Both masks are compared, including sign.
assessments.coverage: Parent block IDs and output block IDs must be increasing and within range. Missing parent blocks are zero; missing emitted children or blocks are compared as zero. Complete target comparison requires contiguous ranges from block zero through the fixed production carrier end, covering every child tail.
assessments.mutation: The current comparator changes exactly child 15, lane 53 of the final target block after validated mask extraction and requires the exact localized compare_block error. This checks the value comparator; it does not claim to mutate and reparse a saved Mat file.

required_execution_checks_pending: Build and audit the final stored split and selected honest-witness bridge; run the actual Lean executable.
Compare all actual child coefficients over complete ranges from the recorded Lean R parent bytes, including the existing localized final-tail mutation.
Use a small positive parent case with 0, +1, -1, +(B-1), and -(B-1) to check signs, zero omission, and child 15; reject separate +B, -B, and canonical word p cases.
retained_boundaries: Parent provenance is an execution/evidence link; the input file header alone does not authenticate a Lean producer.
Complete execution, time, and peak memory remain pending until the coordinator records the runs.
